9a848662cbdb.en: Anthropic or OpenAI with your own API key: the text you ask about (for example a task list or a project description) is sent directly from your device to that provider. We are not involved, and that provider’s privacy policy applies. Your key is stored in your Keychain (synced with iCloud Keychain only if you turn that on). AI Settings in the app shows what gets sent.
